_notes: Register (V31 open item): Student web app and student-facing mobile strings (mobile:student.*, signup.*, login.*, more.*, plan.*, settings.*, v3.appStatus/application/discover/documents/home/journey/match/messages/offer/profile/push/quick/university/upload/visa, v4.application/home/university/visa) use one warm, informal 'Ty' (Cię/Twój, capitalised as Polish consumer apps do). Staff-facing agency strings (mobile:agency.*, v3.agency.*, v3.reviews.*, v3.tasks.*, v3.deadlines.*, v3.settings.*, messages.internal*) use concise operational 'Ty' or impersonal forms. University strings (mobile:university.*, v3.uni.*, v26.uni.*, v4.uni.*) use formal 'Państwo' or impersonal forms; no 'Ty' remains there. Gendered past-tense forms were avoided everywhere (e.g. 'Przyjmuję do wiadomości' instead of 'Zapoznałem(-am) się', 'Masz już status studenta' for 'You're enrolled').

Application (admissions): the existing Polish mixed 'aplikacja', 'wniosek' and 'zgłoszenie'. Unified on 'aplikacja' (the word Polish students use for applying abroad; it was already the majority form and the tab name). 'Wniosek' is kept only for the visa application ('wniosek wizowy'), which is the official Polish term. Where 'aplikacja' could mean the mobile app, the text says 'aplikacja mobilna' / 'w przeglądarce' / 'wersja internetowa' so the two meanings never sit in one sentence.

Plan (purchasable package): the glossary says 'plan', not 'package'; v15/v26/v29 strings used 'pakiet' while v17/v21 used 'plan'. Unified on 'plan' (Twój plan, Plany usług, Plan Premium). 'Plan kosztów' (cost plan) and 'plan nauki' (study plan essay) keep their own qualifier so they do not collide with it.

Study plan (학업계획서) is 'plan nauki' everywhere (was also 'plan studiów', which in Polish usually means the curriculum). Personal statement stays 'list motywacyjny', the term Polish applicants use. Essay editing is 'redakcja', not 'sprawdzanie' (review), to match 'editing' in the English.

Document review vs verification: student-facing review is 'sprawdzanie/sprawdzić' (the team checks the document); 'weryfikacja/zweryfikuj' is kept only for the agency's official verify action (mobile:agency.reviews.verify, v3.reviews.*) and the 'Documents · verified' counter, as the glossary reserves it.

Official names kept official: 'standardowy list przyjęcia' (표준입학허가서), 'list przyjęcia' (admission letter), 'apostille' (indeclinable, as used by Polish authorities), 'legalizacja konsularna', 'poświadczenie notarialne', 'wiza D-2 / D-4', 'GKS', 'TOPIK', 'rozmowa kwalifikacyjna' for the admission interview and 'próbna rozmowa kwalifikacyjna' for mock interview. 'Enrolled' is 'immatrykulacja' in university strings and 'Masz już status studenta' for the student.

Plurals: Polish needs one/few/many (and other for fractions). Every key that had only _one/_other received _few and _many, and _other was set to the 'many' form; several existing _other forms were wrong genitive singulars ('{{count}} nieprzeczytanej wiadomości', '{{count}} dokumentu wymaga', '{{count}} komentarza', '{{count}} innego zadania') and are corrected. mobile:v3.deadlines.bucket.* had only _other; _one/_few/_many were added with the same text so the lookup never falls through. For v22.home.appsQuiet the count was moved into parentheses ('Wszystkie Twoje aplikacje ({{count}})') so the verb never has to agree with the number.

'Closes {{date}}' (application closing date) is 'Nabór do {{date}}' rather than 'Zamknięcie {{date}}', which reads as a closure. 'Expired. Renew it' is 'Wygasł. Odnów go' because 'Nieważny' reads as 'invalid'. Visa F is 'pobyt lub rodzina' (the F family is not only permanent residence).

Hangyul team: every remaining 'doradca' / 'konsultant' in student-facing copy (v3.home.nextBody.ESSAY_WRITE, v4.application.reviewLate, v4.application.writeOnWeb, v4.home.item.WRITE_ESSAY.text, v17.gate.what.help) is aligned to 'zespół Hangyul' / 'zespół Hangyul Univ', following the English. 'Counselor' survives only in staff-facing agency/university strings as 'opiekun'.

Greetings: Polish has no afternoon greeting, so 'Good afternoon' is 'Dzień dobry' like the morning form. Document-language names are lower-case adjectives (angielski, koreański) as Polish writes language names.

Consent summaries: mobile:signup.consent.CROSS_BORDER_VERIFICATION.summary listed 'scope, deadlines, retention period' that the English does not; aligned to the web wording. PRIVACY.summary said 'hash hasła' on the web; now 'hasło (przechowywane w postaci zaszyfrowanej)' on both. No outcome promises were added or dropped; 'scholarships you may qualify for' stays conditional ('o które możesz się ubiegać').

Owner decisions needed: (1) student:onboarding.education.institutionPh and sponsor.goalPh are localised to Polish examples ('Uniwersytet Warszawski', 'firmami koreańskimi i polskimi') like other markets; confirm or keep the Vietnamese examples. (2) 'Teksty' is used for the Writing section title (student:writing.title) to match v22.home.writing, which already said 'Teksty'; 'Pisanie' can be restored if the section title must name the activity. (3) 'Zaznacz wszystkie' (mobile:signup.consentAll) was kept for 'Agree to all' as the common Polish checkbox-group label; say if a literal 'Zgadzam się na wszystko' is required legally.
